visual_elements.description: Self-attention data-flow diagram inside one peach rounded container. LEFT: tan label 'KEYs' above a vertical stack of 4 identical vector bars — each a green dashed rounded rectangle split into 4 abutting segments (pale yellow, pink, pale green, pale violet) with a red subscripted 'X₂' on the 2nd segment; red circle badge 'K' to the right of the stack. CENTER-LEFT: vertical gray-tan rectangle titled 'Dot Product' (dark red, two lines) containing 4 blue circular nodes (dark-blue ring, light-blue center) on a slight diagonal; red arrows run from each of the 4 KEY bars to its node and from each node rightward into the Softmax box; line weights vary — 3rd arrow thickest, 2nd medium, 1st and 4th thin — encoding relevance percentage (no numeric percentages printed). CENTER: vertical orchid-pink rounded rectangle with 'Soft max' rotated 90°. CENTER-RIGHT: vertical column of 4 small red-outlined circles each containing an asterisk (multiply nodes), black labels W₂₁, W₂₂, W₂₃, W₂₄ at their left; red arrows from the Softmax right edge to each node, horizontal red arrows from each of the 4 Value bars leftward into each node, and red arrows rising from each node into the Σ box. TOP-CENTER-RIGHT: pale-blue rectangle with large black 'Σ'; thick green arrow from Σ top up into the output vector — a green dashed bar with segments pale yellow, pink, pale green labeled 'Y' (green bold), pale gray-green. RIGHT: tan label 'Values' above a stack of 4 vector bars identical to the KEYs; red circle badge 'V' at left of stack. BOTTOM-LEFT: orange rounded box 'Query / ALL Keys with X₂' with red circle badge 'Q' at its right; below it a horizontal row of 4 vector bars where the 2nd bar is filled magenta with magenta 'X₂'; a thick red arrow points up into that highlighted bar; a red dashed curved arrow runs from the row's left end up to the bottom of the KEYs stack (query matched against all keys).
visual_elements.position: entire area below the title, ~4-96% width, ~21-99% height

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title bold ~26-28pt on line 1, second line slightly smaller (~18-20pt) and also bold; yellow highlight behind the title's parenthetical; selected words in the subtitle colored red with a true subscript 2 in X₂. All diagram labels bold ~12-14pt; callout text bold italic; 'Soft max' rotated 90° to read vertically; W₂₁-W₂₄ and X₂ use subscripted numerals; result-box text mixes bold-italic emphasis words with regular blue text; slide number is small plain text in a circle. No serif fonts, no all-caps styling beyond what is transcribed (KEYs, VALUES, ALL as written).
animation_state: Slide appears fully built and static: all four key/value pairs, all arrows, both callouts, the result box and all labels are visible simultaneously; no mid-build (partial bullet reveal) state detected.
recreation_brief:
1. Slide setup: create a 16:9 slide with white (#FFFFFF) background; draw a dark-red (#990000) rounded-rectangle border, ~3pt line, inset ~0.15in from every edge, framing the whole slide.
2. Title line 1: one centered text box at ~10-90% width, ~8-14% height; bold sans-serif ~26-28pt black (#000000): 'Self Attention Mechanism (as Query and {Key-Value} Dictionary)' with a yellow (#FFFF00) text-highlight behind the parenthetical '(as Query and {Key-Value} Dictionary)'.
3. Title line 2 (subtitle): second centered text box at ~10-90% width, ~14-19% height; bold ~18-20pt: '(Query using X₂ All Keys in Dictionary and retrieve Corresponding Values' (verbatim, unclosed parenthesis); color the words 'Query', 'X₂', 'All Keys' and 'Values' red (#D40000), remaining text black; render the 2 in X₂ as a true subscript.
4. Slide-number badge: yellow (#FFFF00) circle ~0.45in diameter with thin dark (#333333) outline at ~90-95% width, ~10-17% height; small plain dark (#333333) text '29' centered in it.
5. Main diagram panel: peach (#FBDFBD) rounded rectangle with thin dark-red outline covering ~4-96% width and ~21-99% height (from just below the subtitle to the bottom border); place all remaining elements inside it.
6. Vector-bar master shape (reused 12 times for key/value/query bars): green (#00A651) dashed rounded rectangle ~1.7in x 0.38in split into 4 abutting segments colored left-to-right #FFFF99, #FF99CC, #99FF66, #E6C8E6, with a red (#C00000) subscripted 'X₂' on segment 2.
7. KEYs stack: 4 master bars stacked vertically at ~6-15% width, ~36-73% height; tan (#E8C79A) rounded label box with dark-red (#990000) bold 'KEYs' at the top of the stack; red (#C00000) circle badge with bold red 'K' to the right of the stack.
8. Values stack: 4 master bars stacked vertically at ~77-89% width, ~36-73% height; tan (#E8C79A) label box with dark-red (#990000) bold 'Values' at the top; red (#C00000) circle badge with bold red 'V' to the left of the stack.
9. Dot Product box: gray-tan (#CDBBA8) vertical rectangle ~1.1in x 3.6in at ~26-36% width, ~35-74% height; dark-red (#990000) bold two-line title 'Dot / Product' at its top; 4 blue circular nodes (~0.18in, #003399 ring, #6699FF center) inside on a slight diagonal.
10. Arrows, KEYs to Dot-Product nodes: 4 red (#C00000) arrows from each KEY bar to its node; top-to-bottom line weights ~1.5pt, ~3pt, ~4.5pt, ~1.5pt (3rd thickest, encoding relevance; no numbers printed).
11. Arrows, nodes to Softmax: 4 red (#C00000) arrows from each node rightward into the Softmax box, same top-to-bottom weights (~1.5pt, ~3pt, ~4.5pt, ~1.5pt).
12. Softmax box: orchid (#DFA0DF) vertical rounded rectangle ~0.5in x 3.6in at ~48-53% width, ~35-74% height; dark-red (#990000) bold 'Soft max' rotated 90° to read vertically.
13. Multiply nodes: 4 circles ~0.22in with red (#C00000) outlines, each containing a red (#C00000) asterisk, stacked vertically at ~52-62% width, ~42-70% height; black bold subscripted labels 'W₂₁', 'W₂₂', 'W₂₃', 'W₂₄' immediately left of each circle.
14. Arrows, Softmax to multiply nodes: 4 red (#C00000) arrows from the Softmax right edge to each multiply node.
15. Arrows, Values to multiply nodes: 4 horizontal red (#C00000) arrows from the left end of each Value bar into its multiply node.
16. Arrows, multiply nodes to Σ: 4 red (#C00000) arrows rising from each multiply node into the Σ box.
17. Σ box: pale-blue (#CCE4FF) rectangle ~1.5in x 0.35in at ~54-68% width, ~30-40% height (directly above the multiply column); black bold 'Σ' ~24pt centered.
18. Output vector: 1 master-bar copy at ~54-68% width, ~22-28% height (directly above the Σ box); keep segments 1-3 (#FFFF99, #FF99CC, #99FF66), recolor segment 4 from #E6C8E6 to pale gray-green (hex not captured; use a muted gray-green, e.g. #C8D8C8); place bold green (#00A651) 'Y' on segment 3; no X₂ label on this bar.
19. Green arrow: thick green (#00A651) arrow from the top edge of the Σ box up into the output vector.
20. Callout 1: light-cyan (#CCFFFF) rounded rectangle at ~33-51% width, ~27-34% height (above the Dot Product box); magenta (#CC00CC) bold italic ~12pt text on two lines: 'Matched KEYS with / Relevance Percentage'.
21. Callout 2: light-cyan (#CCFFFF) rounded rectangle at ~66-88% width, ~27-34% height (top-right of panel); magenta (#CC00CC) bold italic ~12pt text on two lines: 'Retrieve VALUES / Weighted by their Relevance'.
22. Query box: orange (#FAC090) rounded rectangle at ~12-51% width, ~77-84% height; dark-red (#990000) bold two-line text 'Query' (larger) / 'ALL Keys with X₂' (smaller, subscripted 2); red (#C00000) circle badge with bold red 'Q' at the box's right.
23. Query bar row: 4 master bars in a horizontal row below the Query box at ~12-51% width, ~85-98% height; fill the entire 2nd bar magenta (#FF7CCE) and set its 'X₂' label magenta (#CC00CC); bars 1, 3, 4 keep standard colors with red X₂ on segment 2.
24. Query highlight arrow: thick red (#C00000) arrow pointing up into the magenta 2nd bar of the query row.
25. Query-to-KEYs arrow: red (#C00000) dashed curved arrow from the left end of the query row up to the bottom of the KEYs stack.
26. Result box: white (#FFFFFF) rectangle ~2.9in x 0.75in with ~2pt blue (#0000CC) border at ~58-86% width, ~80-93% height; 3 centered lines of blue (#0000CC) text: 'Values of Matched Keys' ('Values' and 'Matched Keys' bold italic), 'are returned', 'when Running Query'.

Added missing accent swatches used by the diagram: #E8C79A (tan KEYs/Values label boxes), #003399/#6699FF (Dot Product node ring/center), #FFFF99/#FF99CC/#99FF66/#E6C8E6 (vector segments), #333333 (slide-number outline/text).

Corrected the output-vector step of recreation_brief: 'recolor its 3rd segment green' was wrong because the template's 3rd segment is already #99FF66; per the diagram description the output bar keeps segments 1-3 and changes segment 4 from #E6C8E6 to pale gray-green, with bold green 'Y' on segment 3.
Replaced the vague 'red connecting arrows of varying thickness' in the Dot Product region with the exact top-to-bottom weight pattern: thin (~1.5pt), medium (~3pt), thickest (~4.5pt), thin (~1.5pt).
Added explicit hexes missing from the brief: #C00000 for K/Q/V badge outlines and letters; #CC00CC for the magenta X₂ on the highlighted query bar.
Harmonized Callout 2's position with layout.regions percentages: ~66-88% width, ~27-34% height (above the Values stack, right of the Σ/output area) instead of the looser 'above Σ/output area'.
Amended the X₂ label note for consistency: red on the 2nd segment of every key/value/query vector except the magenta-highlighted query bar, where it is magenta.
Rewrote recreation_brief as a 26-step ordered checklist placing exactly one element per step, each with verbatim text, position (from region percentages), hex color and shape type.
